'''Kepler''' is an NPC north-east of the [[Modulation Hall]].

==Quests and Events==
{{Quests and Events|Kepler}}
==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(During the quest [[Legacy of the Lasting Night]])
:'''Kelper:''' Rest in peace...
:'''Kelper:''' You will not be forgotten.
:'''Kelper:''' Travel among the stars... Enzo, navigator of Rinascita.
:'''Kelper:''' We will see this through, and the Shorekeeper will guide us to rise once more.
:'''Kelper:''' Rest easy, my friend.
----
;(During the quest [[Advance toward the Future from Today]])
:'''Kelper:''' Enzo, my old friend...
:'''Kelper:''' If you're shining somewhere in this starry sky, please watch over us.
:'''Kelper:''' Watch over the Black Shores, watch over the Shorekeeper...
:'''Kelper:''' Let your starlight keep lighting our way forward.
:'''Kelper:''' We will keep fighting for you...
----
;(After completion of [[Beyond the Shore's End]], outside from his previous location)
;(Kepler can no longer be interacted with, but the Recording Machine next to him can)
:'''Nessa's Last Message:''' "My dearest Kepler..."
:'''Nessa's Last Message:''' "Did you know? If one chooses to plunge into the torrent of data, they choose to be disintegrated as bits of digits, becoming a dot in a boundless atlas of stars..."
:'''Nessa's Last Message:''' "The discrete computational representation of me shall evolve and iterate with the Stellar Matrices of the billions of stars, until 'I' am present everywhere and yet nowhere to be found."
:'''Nessa's Last Message:''' "After the end of the shifts, conversions, and merges, the odds for the fragments of 'me' to reintegrate into a new me, even for the split of femtosecond, are almost zero."
:'''Nessa's Last Message:''' "Yet, should that infinitesimal chance arise, I would open my eyes as if newly born, seeing everything one last time before dissolving again into the ceaseless flow of stars."
:'''Nessa's Last Message:''' "This journey of mine has no way back, but fear not, my love—whether it's in a distant afterlife or across the light years..."
:'''Nessa's Last Message:''' "...I will always find you."
:'''Nessa's Last Message:''' "Nessa, from Tethys' Deep."
{{Dialogue End}}
